hypothesis: A narrow unresolved-pronoun instruction added to the existing context prompt fixes ambiguity without losing semantic matches, now that eligibility is deterministic.
candidate_origin: Operator-authored; the local model is the evaluated executor, not the candidate author.
development_suite: Existing six public cases; no fresh confirmation data used during development.
confirmation_order: After development passes, commit the exact candidate/configuration/source/gates freeze before authoring fresh inputs or labels. Freeze the completed suite before one confirmation; never retune from its results.
confirmation_provenance: Fresh operator-authored synthetic cases after the candidate freeze. Same agent authored the candidate and cases, so not independent human-labeled production evidence. Case text reaches the local model only during its confirmation call; labels never reach it.
runtime: Pinned Qwen3-8B Q4_K_M / llama.cpp b9603, GPU28, c4096, presence0, temperature0, thinking false; startup allowance120s; semantic timeout5s, paired timeout120s. Docker network none, 4 CPUs, 4 GiB host RAM, no swap.
selection_policy: A passing confirmation may exercise explicit shadow adoption, live use, restart and rollback only in an isolated test session. Keep builtin defaults and user catalog; no automatic context injection or task authority.
